review_candidates.description: Company Description Xceed is a leading multilingual Business Process Outsourcing service provider in the EMEA region, operating more than 10,000 web-enabled multichannel stations. The organization supports key government and commercial clients in 10 different languages across sites in Egypt, Morocco, Mauritius, the UAE, and Saudi Arabia. Xceed delivers a wide range of services, including inbound and outbound customer support, back-office operations, infrastructure management, recruitment process outsourcing, helpdesk support, and social media analysis. The company has received multiple international awards for outsourcing excellence, impact sourcing, customer experience, sustainability, diversity, equity, and inclusion. Xceed is certified to several global standards, including COPC, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 22301, ISO 45001, and ISO/IEC 27001, reflecting its commitment to quality, security, and business continuity. Role Description The Senior Supervisor Application Developer (.NET & AI LLM) is a full-time, on-site role based in Cairo, responsible for leading a development team in designing, building, and maintaining enterprise applications. This role oversees the end-to-end software development lifecycle using .NET technologies and AI Large Language Models, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned with business needs. Daily activities include supervising and mentoring developers, reviewing code and architecture, coordinating with project managers and business stakeholders, and managing task allocation and timelines. The Senior Supervisor also drives technical best practices, contributes to system design for distributed and high-availability environments, and leads continuous improvement initiatives in development processes and tooling. This position requires active collaboration across departments to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions that support Xceed’s BPO and CX operations. Qualifications Strong skills in Software Development and Software Design, particularly with .NET technologies and integration of AI LLM solutions. Proficiency in Project Management, including planning, prioritization, risk management, and coordinating cross-functional stakeholders. Experience with Distributed Systems, scalable architectures, and cloud or hybrid environments. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree is an advantage. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced on-site environment. review_candidates.title: Junior Backend Developer
review_candidates.description: We’re Red Tiger , a dynamic and self-contained team within the vast Evolution ecosystem, thriving with 200 talented professionals based in Sofia. Our expertise spans from product inception to final development, covering product, art, development, and more. Proudly 100% made in Bulgaria, we take immense pride in our achievements, adaptability, and the high quality of our games. Job Description As a Junior Backend Developer in the Backend team, you will contribute to the development and maintenance of a high-performance Online Gambling Platform . This platform supports casino games and their integration with online casino operators worldwide. You will be part of a collaborative team of Backend Developers and QA Engineers who value teamwork, clear feature scopes, code quality, and continuous learning. You will report to the Backend Team Lead and Backend Architect. During your onboarding period, experienced team members will guide you through our internal tools, systems, and engineering best practices. Once onboarded, you will work on maintenance, bug fixing, and developing straightforward features for our core backend services — primarily RESTful APIs, that manage player actions and financial transactions. You will participate in code reviews, write clean and testable code, and collaborate closely with QA Engineers to ensure seamless deployments. Following your training, a personal development plan will be established to help support your long-term career growth. Mission & Responsibilities: Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code adhering to established team standards and guidelines. Assist in developing, maintaining, and optimizing RESTful API services under the guidance of senior team members. Participate actively in the team’s code review process, learning from peer feedback and reviewing code to improve quality. Collaborate closely with QA Engineers to reproduce, troubleshoot, and fix software defects. Apply core software engineering principles in daily development tasks. Engage proactively in team discussions, training opportunities, and continuous learning to expand technical skills. Qualifications Practical experience or strong foundational knowledge in PHP web development. Basic understanding of JavaScript (Node.js or browser-based JS). Working knowledge of relational databases, specifically MySQL or MariaDB (queries, basic schema design). Foundational understanding of Docker for running and navigating containerized local environments. Basic understanding of RESTful API concepts, HTTP methods, and web architecture. Familiarity with Version Control Systems, specifically Git (branching, commits, pull/merge requests). Willingness and openness to work with plain/vanilla PHP when required, as well as frameworks. Strong problem-solving aptitude, eagerness to learn, and strong team-oriented communication skills. Fluency in English is a must Advantages: Understanding of fundamental software design principles. Hands-on experience or coursework involving Node.js. Familiarity with unit and integration testing tools (e.g., PHPUnit, Codeception). Basic understanding of web servers such as Nginx or Apache. Knowledge of basic CI/CD concepts or automated deployment tools. Additional Information Tech Stack & Tools: Primary Programming Languages: PHP (7.4+), JavaScript / Node.js (21+) Database Management: MySQL / MariaDB (10.4+) Containerization & Infrastructure: Docker Architecture & Protocols: REST APIs, JSON Version Control & Collaboration: Git / GitLab What we offer: Environment tailored to allow you to realize your full potential Challenging work in a dynamic international team Company funded training. Flexibility on working hours Multisport/Coolfit card; Additional health insurance.
